description:
*“Number 11, you keep catching my eye.”*

When a sudden fire breaks out, an omega escapes from the breeding facility and ends up in a gene-trait brothel called 'STUD'. There, in control of Section C, reigns Lee Beomjae. Whether it was bad luck or a single mistake that started it all, he keeps crossing paths with Yoo Jeong-ah (No. 11) - an omega with nothing but his secondary gender to his name. Even when the establishment is shut down for cleaning, or when he’s suddenly dragged to Section A to serve a client, fate seems to throw him in Beomjae’s way again and again. But this isn’t a fairytale forest - it’s a pit of filth. There’s no princess here.

*“I think I’m going to die. I need an alpha. Or at least something I can use, sir… If I can’t right now, I’ll die- I said I’ll die.”  
“...Damn it.”*

No knight is coming to save someone who walked into the mire on his own. Only a monster stands guard - making sure he never escapes. After all, this place is the sewer.

---
